subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

The (1)___ conference room was (2)___ with comfortable chairs, sleek tables and advanced multimedia systems for presentations, creating a professional (3)___ for meetings.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**spacious**" means having ample space.
 
• The conference room is described as spacious, equipped with comfortable chairs, sleek tables, and advanced multimedia systems, creating a professional environment for meetings.
 
• The other options do not align properly with the blank placements in the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The spacious__ conference room was __equipped__ with comfortable chairs, sleek tables and advanced multimedia systems for presentations, creating a professional __environment__ for meetings.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Spacious**: having ample space.
 
• **Equipped**: provided with necessary items for a particular purpose.
 
• **Environment**: the setting or conditions in which a particular activity is carried out.
